Subject: Selwyn Living Communities - Referral Required

Hi Leon,

Thanks for the submission on Selwyn Living Communities.

I've reviewed the account and need to refer this to our senior underwriting team due to the following:

• 2 locations are within 16 km of the coast
• Our existing portfolio already has high coastal accumulation within 25 km of these properties

Before I can move this forward, I need answers to these questions:

1. What specific coastal protection measures are in place at each location?
2. Can you provide exact distances from coastline for both properties?
3. Are there any hurricane/windstorm mitigation features (shutters, reinforced roofing, etc.)?

Given the coastal exposure concentration, you may also want to consider reaching out to a specialty coastal property market for competitive terms.

I'll follow up once I hear back.

Best,
[Underwriter name]
